101B.5 / CHAPTER 5 OF 9

The self rug

Is your own decision making becoming the biggest risk?

9 chapters with worked investigations

01Thesis vs hygiene02Immediate rug risk03Slow extraction04Organic slow death05The self rug06Token cycle, meta cycle & attention07Due diligence keeps moving08Clear decision states09The basic dev view

01Definition

A self rug is trader shorthand for turning manageable exposure into a severe loss through poor decisions.

02Why it matters

A token can remain tradable while your position becomes unmanageable.

03What to check

  • Exposure relative to your written loss and execution plan
  • Evidence that invalidates the thesis
  • Whether averaging, leverage, or chasing overrides the plan

04Healthy / Dangerous

Healthy

Decisions follow defined conditions and current executable quotes.

Dangerous

Sunk cost or community excitement replaces the original plan.

05Beginner mistake

Calling refusal to reassess conviction.

06Takeaway

A clean token can still become a bad trade.

ILLUSTRATIVE · NOT A LIVE TOKEN

WORKED INVESTIGATION · ILLUSTRATIVE

Work through the evidence

Mechanism and worked case

A trader budgets $100 of exposure, then adds $100 after a decline and $200 to recover losses. Total capital exposed becomes $400 even though the original plan was $100. The token need not change for the trader to create a larger loss.

How to investigate it

Before entry, write the maximum cash loss, maximum total exposure, evidence that invalidates the idea, and an execution plan. After each proposed add, recompute those amounts. In thin tokens, a stop is an instruction rather than a guaranteed price; test current quotes and allow for worse execution or complete loss.

Check your reasoning — answered

A $100 position falls to $60 and you add $100. Is only $160 at risk? Current position value may be $160, but total committed capital is $200. Track both original cash and current exposure rather than using the cheaper price to reset the budget.

Trace it externally

Use your position record and current execution quotes. Meme Fast does not verify your portfolio exposure or enforce your exit plan.

Go deeper

Chasing, unplanned averaging, excessive leverage, ignored distribution, and deteriorating liquidity can compound exposure. A stop trigger is not a guaranteed fill or maximum loss. The source reserves detailed position management for 303A; this chapter introduces the distinction without prescribing sizing or profit targets.
